sources.title: UK Parliament, Indian Independence Act 1947
sources.note: Primary statute, sections 1 and 2. Original indexed text checked; direct PDF returned HTTP 429. Independence on 15 August 1947 created two independent Dominions, not the republic of 1950.

sources.title: Government of India, Constitution of India, 2024 edition
sources.note: Direct original PDF extraction checked: preamble PDF page 32, Articles 1, 14 to 17, 74, 75 and 394. Edition updated to 1 May 2024. Combine with Hindi edition as one underlying constitutional work.

sources.title: Government of India, Constitution of India, Hindi edition (2024)
sources.note: Original indexed preamble exposes हम, भारत के लोग. Full PDF exceeds web extraction size limit; no visual facsimile verification claimed. Translation independently checked in official English preamble. Modern edition, not a claimed 1949 manuscript witness. Combine its derived words with the English constitution.

sources.title: NCERT, Politics in India Since Independence, chapter 1: Challenges of Nation Building
sources.note: Original NCERT chapter text read in full reproduction at https://philoid.com/ncert/chapter/leps201 because original server was inaccessible. Integration of Princely States and Reorganisation of States sections. Combine chapters 1 and 6 as one book.

sources.title: NCERT, Politics in India Since Independence, chapter 6: The Crisis of Democratic Order
sources.note: Original NCERT chapter reproduced at https://philoid.com/ncert/chapter/leps206, directly read. Declaration of Emergency, consequences, and 1977 elections sections. Original PDF inaccessible. Same underlying book as chapter 1.

sources.title: Partition Museum, Art: Jogen Chowdhury
sources.note: Original museum entry directly read. Refugees in Sealdah railway station, black ink drawing, 1958, created at age 19 from observation of refugees in the aftermath of Partition.

sources.title: Election Commission of India, illustrated account of Indian elections: the first elections and balloting system
sources.note: Original 142-page PDF directly read. Printed pages 10 and 14 (PDF pages 18 and 22) document symbol-marked separate ballot boxes in 1951 to 1952 and 1957. Descriptive source title used because extracted PDF metadata says 1-20.indd.

sources.title: Reserve Bank of India, RBI’s Functions and Working (7 August 2020)
sources.note: Original HTML directly read after initial fetch failure. Chapters 12 and 18: two-step exchange-rate adjustment in 1991, LERMS in 1992, and unified market-determined exchange rate in 1993.

sources.title: National Dairy Development Board, Operation Flood
sources.note: Original institutional indexed text checked. Programme launched in 1970; village dairy cooperatives, National Milk Grid, animal health/feed services and member education. Phase III discussion records increasing women members and women dairy cooperative societies.

sources.title: Akshaya Patra Foundation, Our Work
sources.note: Original operator account directly read. School meals under PM POSHAN for primary and upper-primary children in government and government-aided schools. Operator describes its own work, not all Indian schools.

sources.title: Akshaya Patra Foundation, Centralised Kitchens
sources.note: Original account directly read. First roti machine introduced in 2002, producing 10,000 rotis per hour; rice chutes, cauldrons, semi-automated cooking. Historical capacity distinguished from changing present totals.

sources.title: Aravind Eye Care System, Our Story
sources.note: Original institutional indexed account checked: G. Venkataswamy founded an 11-bed hospital in Madurai in 1976 after retirement; paying and subsidised or free care. No current patient totals used.

sources.title: Aravind Eye Care System, Aurolab
sources.note: Original institutional indexed account checked: nonprofit manufacturer founded in 1992 to make intraocular lenses and other ophthalmic supplies affordable. Context also checked against original-author article Cataract surgery at Aravind Eye Hospitals: 1988 to 2008, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2580063/.

sources.title: WHO, South-East Asia marks 15 years since the last case of wild poliovirus (13 January 2026)
sources.note: Original indexed WHO release checked. Last regional wild-poliovirus case in Howrah on 13 January 2011; regional certification in 2014; continuing immunisation and surveillance essential. Dated statement, not a claim all polio vanished globally.

sources.title: WHO, A push to vaccinate every child, everywhere, ended polio in India (7 April 2021)
sources.note: Original WHO indexed feature checked: house-to-house, school and transit vaccination, plus work with community and religious leaders. Retrospective programme account; do not generalize to every contemporary health service.

sources.title: UNICEF India, Giving girls safe spaces to fly (25 March 2025)
sources.note: Original directly read. Adarsh Ramanand Middle School, Garhbaneli, Purnea, Bihar: Saheli Kaksh, menstrual products, rest bed, spare uniforms, eight girls toilets, handwashing, class water drums, composting and mother Sita Devi testimony. Named school example, not a national outcome evaluation.

sources.title: UNICEF India, Lighting the way: how rural women are redefining leadership (17 June 2025)
sources.note: Original directly read. Sita Sardar of Ulidih, Tantnagar, West Singhbhum, Jharkhand: Jal Sahiya water work, committee formation, water-quality testing, greywater, and election as Mukhiya in 2022.

sources.title: UNESCO, Durga Puja in Kolkata, inscribed 2021
sources.note: Original institutional description read: ten-day festival, workshops using unfired Ganga clay, painting eyes on Mahalaya, immersion, and public pavilions. Regional Hindu tradition, not a universal Indian household practice.

sources.title: ISRO, Release of Chandrayaan-3 science data to the scientific community (23 August 2024)
sources.note: Original agency indexed release checked: 23 August 2023 landing at southern high latitudes, Pragyan travelled approximately 101 metres, instruments studied temperature, plasma, seismicity and composition; public science-data release in 2024.

sources.title: ISRO, Chandrayaan-3 mission updates
sources.note: Original mission updates checked, especially 28 August 2023 LIBS identification of sulphur and 30 August APXS elemental measurements. Treat with data-release article as one conservative mission work group.

proposedOverrides.name: India
proposedOverrides.summary: India’s colonial, independent Dominion and republican phases require separate dates.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: Separate phased card, no association with british-raj or any earlier Indian empire.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: world-1938 polygon is near Strait of Hormuz, bbox [56.062,25.462,56.404,26.237], and cannot depict India. From world-1945 the polygon covers the subcontinent but is a coarse later outline crossing independence. Later northern boundaries differ; this imported geometry is not a sovereignty claim.
batchIdentityNotes.publicTreatment: Overview exposes displaced polygon and Partition/disputed-border limitations; phases explicitly separate colonial, Dominion and republican history. Republic alias does not apply to pre-1950 India.
batchIdentityNotes.intervalNote: Final phase ends at exclusive 2027 only to display reports through 2026; this is not a forecast or fall date.
